title: Raku Firing Workshops
source_quote: RAKU FIRING WORKSHOPS Bradley offers immersive raku firing workshops for students, where participants engage in the full process—from glazing and unconventional loading to live reduction firing and post-firing cleanup.
evidence_sentence: The homepage describes immersive raku firing workshops where participants glaze, load, engage in live reduction firing, and leave with finished pieces.
evidence_quote: Bradley offers immersive raku firing workshops for students, where participants engage in the full process—from glazing and unconventional loading to live reduction firing and post-firing cleanup. Attendees experience the excitement and unpredictability of raku, learning about thermal shock, rapid cooling, and the effects of reduction on glaze surfaces with various reduction materials.
summary: Bradley leads immersive raku firing workshops where participants glaze their work, experience live reduction firing, and take home finished pieces.
how_to_join: Contact Bradley B. Pottery at (571) 606-8468 or bradleybpotter@gmail.com
